# KCONE Pilates

> KCONE Pilates is a China-based manufacturer of professional Pilates equipment for studios, distributors, fitness chains, training academies, wellness spaces, and rehabilitation-oriented facilities.

## Product Catalog

- [Professional Pilates Equipment Manufacturer](https://kconepilates.com/): Main brand, product collection, factory information, engineering standards, FAQ, and inquiry form.
- [Reformer H02](https://kconepilates.com/h02-detail): Commercial Pilates reformer with carbon steel frame, 150 kg capacity, 10-gear handle, 5-spring system, and patented 360-degree silent pulley.
- [Wunda Chair W01](https://kconepilates.com/w01-detail): Professional Pilates chair with carbon steel frame, 5 handle positions, 3 spring tensions, and 4-parameter spring system.
- [Ladder Barrel T02](https://kconepilates.com/t02-detail): Professional Pilates ladder barrel with carbon steel frame, 5-gear barrel adjustment, and 42 mm coated handles.
- [Cadillac K21](https://kconepilates.com/k21-detail): Professional Pilates Cadillac / Trapeze Table with 304 stainless steel frame, German-made springs, and 10-parameter spring system.
- [Tower H21](https://kconepilates.com/h21-detail): Professional Pilates tower with 304 stainless steel frame, 16 stainless steel hooks, and 8-parameter spring system.
- [Spine Corrector J01](https://kconepilates.com/j01-detail): Professional Pilates spine corrector with imported leather wrap and ergonomic carry handle.
- [Reformer KC01](https://kconepilates.com/kc01-detail): Professional Pilates reformer with 130 kg capacity, 7-gear handle, 5-spring system, and KCONE signature blue rope.
- [Reformer M01](https://kconepilates.com/m01-detail): Professional Pilates reformer with anodized aluminum finish, Merrithew SPX compatibility, and standard or high-leg versions.
- [Chair MW01](https://kconepilates.com/mw01-detail): Multi-function Pilates chair / Wunda chair with natural wood and aluminum frame, 8 handle height positions, and KCONE brand identity strap.
- [PowerHouse RX](https://kconepilates.com/rx-detail): Upright dual-rail rehab Pilates trainer with lightweight aluminum frame and zinc-nickel alloy springs tested for 800,000+ cycles.
- [KCONE Blog](https://kconepilates.com/blog): Articles about Pilates equipment, studio setup, manufacturing, and industry topics.

## Business Information

KCONE works directly with studios, distributors, and fitness chains worldwide. The website is inquiry-based rather than public-price ecommerce. Buyers can request KCONE product specifications, quotation, MOQ details, lead times, and FOB export packaging information. KCONE is a proprietary brand manufacturer focused on its own branded professional Pilates equipment collection.

KCONE supports product review through specifications, photos, videos, FOB export packaging details, lead time, and quotation discussions before order confirmation.

Compliance requirements vary by destination port and order scope. Buyers should confirm any import, studio, medical, or regulatory requirements before ordering.
